title: List my devices success
preconditions: U1 has >=3 devices and valid access token
steps: 1) GET /api/v1/me/devices 2) Verify payload 3) Verify DB owner scope
expected_result: 200; only U1 devices; fields include status/last_seen

title: Revoke own device success
preconditions: U1 owns D2; D2 not revoked
steps: 1) POST /api/v1/me/devices/D2/revoke 2) Check DB devices 3) Check DB refresh_tokens
expected_result: 204; D2 status revoked; related refresh tokens invalidated

title: Revoke other user device denied
preconditions: U1 token; D-U2 belongs to U2
expected_result: 403/denied generic; no ownership leak; DB unchanged

title: Logout other devices success
preconditions: U1 current device D1 + D2,D3 active
steps: 1) POST /api/v1/me/devices/logout-others 2) Check devices 3) Check refresh tokens
expected_result: 200; D2,D3 revoked; D1 remains active; non-D1 sessions revoked

title: Logout all devices success
preconditions: U1 has active devices and sessions
steps: 1) POST /api/v1/me/devices/logout-all 2) Verify all devices and sessions
expected_result: 200; all U1 devices revoked; all U1 refresh tokens removed

title: Refresh denied after device revoked
preconditions: Refresh cookie tied to revoked device D2

title: Concurrent logout-others idempotency
steps: 1) Fire concurrent POST logout-others 2) Verify final state
expected_result: No corruption; final state equal to single successful run
